messages:
olivia_oncall: noticing elevated 500s on /v1/embeddings canary right after deploy, rolling back? :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=embedder, image=embedder:v3.2-canary, region=us-west-2, id=canary-0421
carla_infra: looking at canary logs now, seeing JSON parse errors from secrets loader
ryan_runtime: logs snippet:
```
Error: invalid service account JSON: unexpected end of input
at parseServiceAccount (/app/src/keys.js:112:15)
at initClient (/app/src/clients/kv.js:58:7)
```
maya_sre: metric spike: request_error_rate for embedder-canary = 8.4% (baseline 0.2%) and tail latency up ~4x
luca_support: inbound error reports from three enterprise customers referencing API error 502, flagging severity P2 customer impact
olivia_oncall: canary looks bad, kill-switch ready. I'm going to flip the feature flag that enables new secret path. Paging on-call to incident channel. @incident-bot please create incident
incident-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-0421-embedder-secrets (severity: high). Pager sent to on-call rotation. Runbook: secrets-deploy-failure -> follow canary rollback flow
carla_infra: quick check — the new secret was uploaded as base64 but appears double-encoded; decoded payload is still base64 gibberish. Example: `NEW_SA_B64=U0EtZGF0YTpVQjE2...` but decoding once yields another base64 blob instead of JSON
ryan_runtime: that explains parse error. The loader expects raw JSON after single base64 decode. Strange, CI step that rotated keys might have applied `base64 | base64` by mistake.
olivia_oncall: mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to bypass new secret path (fast) 2) rollback the canary image (fast) 3) hotfix re-encode secret in secrets manager (risky, needs perms)
maya_sre: recommend flip flag + rollback canary to stop customer impact immediately
luca_support: please add a public incident note: short blurb for affected customers, ETA for rollback.
olivia_oncall: executing flag kill-switch now: `deploy-tool feature-toggle set embedder:use_new_secrets false --env prod`
(deploy-tool): OK — feature toggle embedder:use_new_secrets=false applied to prod
olivia_oncall: initiating canary abort + rollback to embedder:v3.1-stable
deploy-bot: Rollback started: service=embedder target=image=embedder:v3.1-stable initiated by olivia_oncall
carla_infra: contacting secrets manager lead — will sanitize the uploaded secret and rotate with correct single-base64 encoding, but that will take ~20-30m and requires key unwrap perms
ryan_runtime: rollback progressing, canary pods terminating, stable pods scaling up. Watching error budget and 5xx rate
maya_sre: after flag flip we've seen error rate drop to 0.6% within 45s — trending down
luca_support: posting initial customer status: "We've identified a deployment-related configuration issue affecting some embeddings calls. The canary has been aborted and rolled back; mitigation is in progress. We'll update in 30 minutes."
olivia_oncall: handoff to ryan_runtime for post-rollback validation and secret remediation communications. I'm stepping off but will stay available if escalation needed. @ryan_runtime you have incident lead
ryan_runtime: taking lead. I'll validate certs/keys and coordinate with carla for secret reupload. Creating checklist: 1) confirm all prod pods back at v3.1 2) validate embedder health 3) rotate sanitized secret 4) run canary in staging with decoder check
carla_infra: I have a sanitized copy staging-ready, will need KMS decrypt and IAM to put in secrets manager. Pinged infra-ops for perms now (ticket #INFRA-5538)
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-embedder-secrets status: mitigation applied (flag off, rollback started). Pager de-escalated to follow-up.
ryan_runtime: quick verification: stable pods at 12/12 ready, error rate back to baseline 0.18%, 95p latency normal. Marking customer-impact mitigated.
maya_sre: recommend postmortem and CI gate added to check base64 layering on secret rotations
luca_support: will draft post-incident customer note and follow up with affected accounts individually
olivia_oncall: thanks team. I'll file the incident doc and include timeline + root cause hypothesis: CI rotation step double-encoded base64 payload.
ryan_runtime: filing follow-ups: add IAM check to rotation runbook, add automated decode-verify step in secrets pipeline, and require a canary decode check before promo.
carla_infra: INFRA-5538 approved, proceeding with sanitized secret rotate; I'll post when done
ryan_runtime: thanks — closing thread for live mitigation. We'll convene a brief postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
